text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That was quite a stimulating flavor. Thank 
you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Well, fine. If it's fed on my 
"experience"..."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There's no way you'd get done in by some 
naive, clueless little lady, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh my... you are quite kind, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're still the better option between the 
two.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
How about some "authentic" French cuisine? 
Allow me to escort you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds interesting. I'd gladly take you 
up on that."

After the race, Mejiro Ramonu looked 
somewhat cheerful. At least, that was the 
impression I got...
